selection.ownership: Eventzilla Corporation (Dublin, OH, United States; AWS us-east-1). Global event-registration product at eventzilla.net, not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Eventzilla API v2 (host https://www.eventzillaapi.net/api/v2, x-api-key, GET /users, /events, /events/{eventid}, /events/{eventid}/tickets, /users/{userid}, offset/limit paging, 401 for missing or invalid keys), Eventzilla Corporation privacy/DPA identity (Ohio law, 545 Metro Place South, Dublin OH), and dated incident search. No qualifying current unresolved Eventzilla compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Eventzilla API v2 documents HTTPS host https://www.eventzillaapi.net/api/v2, x-api-key header, GET /users, GET /events with status/category/offset/limit, GET /events/{eventid}, GET /events/{eventid}/tickets, GET /users/{userid}, and 401 for missing or invalid keys. Operator is Eventzilla Corporation, Ohio USA, with primary hosting in AWS us-east-1. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved Eventzilla compromise.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Eventzilla / Eventzilla Corporation security breach and incident coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /users with offset=0&limit=1, matching the pinned validator. Official list-users omits a required query; the validator always sends that page. Checkout, check-in, and other writes are omitted.
Native category is scheduling: Eventzilla is an event-registration platform. Source Productivity/Marketing are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.

Official docs now create keys under Settings > Developers > API Credentials; pinned definition still says Settings > App Management. The wire header remains x-api-key. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Returns raw Eventzilla JSON under data. Optional offset, limit, status, and category use official query names. Native limit is bounded to 1–100; official default is 20 with no published max.
eventid is a required positive integer path segment on GET /events/{eventid}.
Maps to documented GET /events/{eventid}/tickets. Official docs describe the resource as ticket types; the public path remains /tickets for compatibility.
userid is a required positive integer path segment on GET /users/{userid}. Pinned list_users uses a trailing slash on /users/; this get path matches official docs and source without a trailing slash.
Maps to documented GET /users with optional offset and limit.
